text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the VR Umalator to seek healing 
in nature, I found Godolphin Barb cradling 
a cat in her arms.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, surrounded by all this greenery 
feels wonderful, doesn't it? Come, shall 
we play lots?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment it was put down, the cat rubbed 
its head against her feet. It seemed 
exceedingly attached to her—when 
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Amazing... To get along so well 
with kitty-san...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Would you like to become friends 
with my pet cat as well?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eh... N-No! If Rice gets close, animals 
always run away, so...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yet the desire to get along is precious. 
If you wish for it, allow me to assist 
you... How about it?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Open your heart to accept all, just like 
the deep azure sea... Are you ready, 
Rice-chan?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! ...Rice wants to be friends too...!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Greetings are important, but your 
voice seems a little too quiet.

text_block_list.name: Tabby Cat
text_block_list.text: ?! HIIISSSS!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueee! I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Rice Shower tried various 
things like changing spots and offering 
treats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Yet even with Godolphin Barb's advice, 
things did not seem to go well—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: There, there, good girl.

text_block_list.name: Tabby Cat
text_block_list.text: (Purr purr...♪)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Showing its belly and rolling 
around happily...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, Godolphin-san. You helped me 
so much, but as expected... Rice just 
can't—!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ...Say, would you listen to an old story?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
To become friends with all beings— Once 
upon a time, there was a Horse Girl who 
wished for just that. Her name was... 
"Scham".

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Scham" crossed oceans, wandering through 
foreign lands. Amidst her whimsical fate, 
she was supported by kind people—

(Sorry for bringing you so far away... I 
promise, I'll make you happy no matter 
what.)

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
From a mute boy who could not speak, 
"Scham" was taught boundless love.

Amazing, you've gotten faster! Just like 
the wind... You worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
From someone precious, "Scham" was taught 
the wonder of running.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Scham" thought to herself: Even through a 
harsh destiny, surrounded by so much 
kindness, she lived blissful days—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ...So the records are kept.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
How about around you, Rice-chan? Are there 
only people who reject you?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Connecting with someone requires courage, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I understand becoming timid from fear of 
being disliked. However—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! Rice doesn't want to give up... I 
want to try becoming friends with 
kitty-san too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her greeting, the cat gazed steadily at 
her... and softly swished its tail.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Rice Shower continued speaking 
softly to become friends... Watching this 
scene, Godolphin Barb smiled gently.
